h1/.lede/inline code all carry overflow-wrap:anywhere; wide tables sit in .table-wrap overflow-x:auto. Screenshot review at 390px caught two real defects pre-report: the unbreakable H1 token DisplayOverrideEntryObject (fixed with <wbr> hints, textContent identical) and the three-column interim compat table crushing its Evidence column into mid-word breaks (fixed with a .compat-table class — first column width auto/min 5rem, second min 6.5rem, cells overflow-wrap:break-word — plus spelling out the platform list so it wraps at spaces). Re-shot mobile (390px) and desktop (1280px) on PORT=3211 and read the crops: no document-level horizontal overflow at either size; pre blocks scroll internally by design (house pattern); the showcase iframe renders the live Display Mode Probe demo on both.

The embed references the canonical CPS feature identity (/v152/unframed-display-mode-for-isolated-web-apps/, HEAD-200) and its display-mode-probe concept (HEAD-200) without forking platform assertions; the figcaption links the showcase as source and states the demo's host-window caveat.

guidanceConsulted.query: npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "web app manifest display mode reference documentation responsive tables" + retrieve "css-layout"
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing and the browser's layout engine; use flexible tracks and min-content/max-content before fixed widths; avoid hardcoded dimensions that force horizontal overflow on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Tables use percentage first-column hints with min-width in rem and overflow-wrap:anywhere instead of fixed pixel widths; wide tables scroll inside .table-wrap rather than forcing document overflow; pre blocks scroll internally.

guidanceConsulted.query: npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "accessible data tables responsive overflow long tokens"
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic HTML first: scoped table headers, captions, landmark structure, and readable focus/reading order.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Every doc-table has a caption and scope=row/col headers; single main landmark; sequential headings; banner uses role=note with aria-label; iframe has a descriptive title.

openQuestions: The explainer does not define a page-observable signal when the window-management permission is denied — the page records the gate but cannot document a rejection event; if the implementation exposes one, the errors section should grow it.

The incubation spec defines app-region in prose only (no formal value-definition grammar, initial value, or inheritance rules); the child page documents drag/no-drag and the MUST-scoping rule and explicitly declines to invent the rest.
Whether a regular-expression url_pattern fails manifest processing or merely never matches is not specified; the child page states the exclusion without claiming a mechanism.

The detail record ('In developer trial (Behind a flag)') and the trunk base feature (ENABLED_BY_DEFAULT) diverge from the listing's two categories; if the Finch stepped rollout completes or the record is updated, the warn-block and compat row should be re-anchored.
